display.purpose: The single Georgia initial in the Larp mark; interface titles remain sans-serif.

headline.purpose: The selected group name in the conversation header.

body.purpose: Default interface copy and supporting text.

confirm.purpose: Forest action; width varies by dialog context.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Compact button, navigation, and composer-border state changes.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Enabled signed-message send action uses the forest accent; disabled actions return to neutral.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 31px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--text); background: var(--accent); border: 0; border-radius: 5px; font: 750 9px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: filter 140ms ease, opacity 140ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.12); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { color: var(--subtle); background: var(--panel-soft); opacity: 1; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Voice Call Action
components.description: Enabled voice-call join action; disabled styling is neutral until the P2P path is ready.
components.css: .ds-call-action { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; color: var(--text); background: var(--accent); border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 5px; font: 700 9px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-call-action:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.12); } .ds-call-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-call-action:disabled { color: var(--subtle); background: var(--panel-soft); border-color: var(--border); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Dialog Confirmation
components.description: Forest action confirms a dialog task; standard dialogs span the row, while group/media dialogs size to context.
components.css: .ds-dialog-confirm { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 40px; color: var(--text); background: var(--accent); border: 0; border-radius: 6px; font: 720 11px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog-confirm:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.12); } .ds-dialog-confirm:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-dialog-confirm:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Control
components.description: Neutral control for device, dialog, and navigation actions.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 11px; color: var(--text); background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; font: 650 10px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--panel-soft); border-color: var(--accent-teal); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-secondary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Destructive Action
components.description: Ruby treatment for revoking an invitation or leaving/removing a group member.
components.css: .ds-button-danger { min-height: 38px; padding: 0 11px; color: var(--text); background: var(--accent-ruby); border: 1px solid var(--accent-ruby); border-radius: 6px; font: 650 10px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-danger:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.12); } .ds-button-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-danger:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Message Composer
components.description: Multiline signed-message entry on a raised surface; focus is carried by the container border.
components.css: .ds-composer { padding: 10px 11px 9px; background: var(--panel-raised); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 7px; transition: border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent-teal); } .ds-composer textarea { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 43px; padding: 0; color: var(--text); background: transparent; border: 0; font: 400 11px/1.55 Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; resize: vertical; } .ds-composer textarea::placeholder { color: var(--muted); opacity: 1; } .ds-composer textarea:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Group Row
components.description: The selected real private group is identified by a teal row and a consistent chat icon.
components.css: .ds-group-selected { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: 6px 9px; color: var(--text); text-align: left; background: var(--accent-teal); border: 1px solid var(--accent-teal); border-radius: 5px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-group-selected:hover { background: var(--accent-teal); } .ds-group-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-group-icon { display: grid; flex: 0 0 auto; width: 32px; height: 32px; place-items: center; color: var(--text); background: var(--accent-teal); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-group-icon svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-group-copy { display: grid; gap: 4px; } .ds-group-copy strong { color: var(--text); font: 650 11px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-group-copy small { color: var(--muted); font: 400 9px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Privacy Chip
components.description: A compact lock-tag for a real private-group state.
components.html: GRUPO PRIVADO
components.css: .ds-privacy-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 5px 7px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--panel-soft); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px; font: 750 8px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; } .ds-privacy-chip svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

components.name: Connection Status Card
components.description: A measured connection state with a short primary label and supporting detail.
components.html: Chat P2P preparadoEstado da conexão
components.css: .ds-connection-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 9px 10px; color: var(--muted); background: var(--panel-raised); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-connection-card > span:nth-child(2) { display: grid; gap: 3px; } .ds-connection-card strong { color: var(--text); font: 680 11px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-connection-card small { color: var(--muted); font: 400 10px/1.35 Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-connection-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; flex: 0 0 auto; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 50%; }

components.name: Local Member Row
components.description: A real local identity is distinct from unverified remote presence.
components.html: PCEste computadorResponsável · neste PC
components.css: .ds-member-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; } .ds-member-avatar { display: grid; width: 28px; height: 28px; flex: 0 0 auto; place-items: center; color: var(--text); background: var(--accent); border-radius: 50%; font: 750 8px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-member-copy { display: grid; min-width: 0; flex: 1; gap: 3px; } .ds-member-copy strong { overflow: hidden; color: var(--text); font: 620 9px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-member-copy small { color: var(--muted); font: 400 8px Inter, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-member-state { width: 7px; height: 7px; flex: 0 0 auto; background: var(--accent); border-radius: 50%; }

narrative.overview:
Larp is a compact, invitation-based room for friends who already know whom they want to talk to. The interface favors shared context and clear permissions over discovery: a group is private, voice and screen sharing start only after an explicit action, and message history stays on members' PCs.

The spatial language borrows Discord's scan order—real groups at left, one active conversation in the center, and group members and actions at right—without importing a public-server browser or invented channel hierarchy. Dark surfaces stay compact and legible; teal marks selection and connection, forest green marks enabled actions, and ruby carries failure or destructive meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Three-pane Windows desktop workspace: groups, conversation, group details and members.
Invitation-based privacy and real membership/connection states.
Layered near-black surfaces, thin separators, restrained semantic accents.
Visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal identifies selection and connection affordances; forest marks enabled actions; ruby is reserved for errors, unavailable state, and destructive actions. Disabled actions return to neutral surfaces.

rules.name: The Group Name Leads Rule
rules.body: The selected group title is the single headline; membership and connection details remain secondary.

dos: Do preserve the exact frontmatter palette roles when adding controls or states.
Do reserve forest green for enabled actions and use neutral styling when an action is disabled.
Do use teal for selection and connection affordances, with off-white labels on teal surfaces.
Do use ruby for destructive/unavailable/error states and pair it with off-white text.
Do distinguish authorized membership from measured reachability; keep focus visible and respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't use dark teal or ruby as small text on dark surfaces.
Don't color a disabled action as if it were ready.
Don't add public-server discovery, channels, invented members, presence, or messages to Larp.
Don't use shadows to separate panels; use the existing tonal layers and 1px borders.
